evidence.rationale: This listing establishes a 2008 GX470 in Salsa Red Pearl over grey leather at 183,333 claimed miles, with a clean title claimed and a $12,500 ask near the bottom of the mileage-adjusted fair-value band. Photos show a tidy exterior and interior, a level stance with no lift, and modest modifications limited to bronze wheels, running boards and a hitch. Nothing is observed wrong in the attached photos. However, none of the model's key risk areas are evidenced. The timing belt at 183k (past two intervals), the rear air suspension, the plastic-tank radiator and the driveline fluids all lack records. Most importantly, the frame and underbody of a Minnesota salt-state vehicle are not examined here. The VIN is partially hidden, so history, owner count and recall status cannot be checked. Maintenance claims are generic seller prose, not receipts.
